viewing_check: Photograph the back of the boss and spokes for a part number or Bluemels/Jaguar stamp, measure rim diameter (16 vs 17 inch), check the rim for cracks or splits, check the horn push for chips and that the boss splines are not worn, and check whether it is adjustable or fixed-boss with a column stub. Also compare with the other Jaguar steering wheel lot in the sale.
